name: Physics I Mechanics: Kinetrix
subtitle: Adaptive Physics I course
shortDescription: Adaptive Physics I mechanics course with quizzes, interactive labs and worked solutions. Free to use.
longDescription:
Kinetrix is an adaptive university physics course for first-year mechanics. It follows the standard syllabus: units and vectors, kinematics, Newton's laws, friction and circular motion, work and energy, momentum and collisions, rotation and torque, angular momentum, static equilibrium, gravitation and orbits, and simple harmonic motion.

### What you get
- **Personalised path:** questions are chosen from your mistakes, weak topics and spaced reviews. Or follow the traditional curriculum order; switch any time.
- **Interactive labs:** projectile motion with air drag, a free-body incline, a collision lab, an orbit sandbox, and spring and pendulum oscillators.
- **More than 300 original problems** with step-by-step worked solutions, common-mistake notes, unit tests and timed mock exams.
- **K-12 to graduate pop-ups** explain any concept at a lower or higher level.
- Sources and further study (such as MIT OpenCourseWare, OpenStax and Khan Academy) open in an in-app window with the licence and a link.

Free with ads, with an optional monthly ad-free plan; cancel any time in your account settings. Not affiliated with or endorsed by MIT, OpenStax, Khan Academy, edX, Coursera, or any university; they are cited as further study only.
